title: finding(spec): 17.3.0 removed four public type exports (`BreakpointName`, `BreakpointColumnMap`, `PreviewModeConfig`, `ResponsiveConfig`) in a `minor` — did the removals carry the launch-window BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 disposition?
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`) as the upstream card the objectui#7122 ruling requires. ⛔ Unassigned, `finding` only; `domain:*` and grading are triage's (the ruling names `domain:spec`).

## The measurement (objectui PR #7685, both registry artifacts unpacked and read directly)

```
symbol               17.2.0    17.3.0
FlowNodeLike         absent    PRESENT
BreakpointName       PRESENT   absent
BreakpointColumnMap  PRESENT   absent
PreviewModeConfig    PRESENT   absent
ResponsiveConfig     PRESENT   absent
```

Four public type exports left `@objectstack/spec` between 17.2.0 and 17.3.0, a `minor` under the launch-window convention. On the consumer side the removals surface as red parity pins in objectui (`packages/auth/src/__tests__/auth-spec-parity.test.ts` for `PreviewModeConfig`; `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` for `ResponsiveConfig`) and as stale ALLOW entries in `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` for the two `Breakpoint*` names.

## The question the ruling asks (director seat, objectui#7122 comment 5549255921, 2026-09-05T04:11Z)

> **file the objectstack card** (`domain:spec`, finding): the question is whether those four removals carried the launch-window BREAKING banner and an adr-0087 disposition. If they did, the card records a known cost of the convention; if they did not, it is a release-gate gap in the spec lane.

A consumer on `^17.0.0` who upgrades within range loses four exported types with no major-version signal — the honesty property objectui's `check-spec-range-floors` was built around.

## One lead, not a conclusion

objectui's `auth-spec-parity.test.ts` header (lines ~277–309) records that objectstack PR #12718 (2026-08-28) removed `PreviewModeConfig` and placed `kernel/PreviewModeConfig` in `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` — i.e. an ADR-0087 disposition **for major 18** exists for at least that one symbol, while the export actually left the package in the 17.3.0 minor. Whether the other three have a disposition at all, and whether the 17.3.0 changelog entries carry the BREAKING banner, is the reading this card owes; this seat did not open the changesets.

## Related

objectui#7122 · objectui PR #7685 · objectstack#14043 (the launch-window convention's end condition) · ADR-0087.
